name: orc
description: One chat to run your AI agent work on all your machines and models, with a backlog, live monitoring and Herdr App dashboards.
author: avi2d <avi2dg@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run bundle && bun packages/run/scripts/build-heavy-standin.ts && (cd packages/session-quota && bun run build) && (cd packages/cli && bun run build) && checks-effect-scope && checks-changelog && bun run build:pack && bun scripts/docs-commands.ts && bun scripts/docs-diagrams.ts
scripts.build:pack: bun run build:launcher && (cd packages/herdr-app && bun run build) && rm -rf packages/run/dist/herdr-app && cp -R packages/herdr-app/dist packages/run/dist/herdr-app && cp CHANGELOG.md packages/run/CHANGELOG.md
scripts.build:launcher: bun run bundle && bun build packages/run/scripts/launch.ts --target node --outfile packages/run/dist/launch.js && install -m 755 packages/run/scripts/launch.sh packages/run/dist/launch
scripts.lint: bun scripts/check-doc-links.ts && bun scripts/check-vue-styles.ts && mkdir -p .orc-home && RUNTIME_BINS="$(dirname "$(bun -p process.execPath)"):$(dirname "$(node -p process.execPath)")" && HOME=$PWD/.orc-home PATH=$PWD/packages/run/scripts:$RUNTIME_BINS:$PATH oxlint && CHECKS_SECRETS_PACK="${CHECKS_SECRETS_PACK-$HOME/.config/checks/secrets-pack.json}" HOME=$PWD/.orc-home PATH=$PWD/packages/run/scripts:$RUNTIME_BINS:$PATH checks-lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.json --format text --strict && bun scripts/vue-typecheck.ts --noEmit -p tsconfig.vue.json
scripts.docs:build: bun run docs:check && vitepress build docs
